newsitem.title: USA: EnviroSource sells unit to IMCO for $58 million.
newsitem.headline: EnviroSource sells unit to IMCO for $58 million.

text.p: EnviroSource Inc. said Wednesday it signed a definitive agreement to sell its IMSAMET unit to IMCO Recycling Inc. for $58 million.
IMSAMET, which has operations in Arizona, Idaho and Utah, recycles scrap and used beverage cans for the aluminum industry.
EnviroSource said it is selling the unit in order to focus on its steel-related businesses, International Mill Service and EnviroSource Treatment & Disposal Services.
The company said proceeds from the sale would be used to reduce bank borrowings. It expects the sale to be completed in late December or early January.
